⚔️ Israeli minister brags about killing Gaza security chief — along with his wife and two daughters Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has publicly announced the assassination of Mohammed Abu al-Awf, the head of internal security in northern Gaza. The airstrike on his apartment in the al-Shati refugee camp also killed his wife Noura (42) and their two teenage daughters, Yusra (15) and Jana (13). Abu al-Awf worked for Gaza's civil government—not Hamas's armed wing. His agency was responsible for tracking down Israeli-backed gangs (including drug dealers Israel has armed) and breaking up Israeli spy networks. He then openly outlined the ultimate goal of the campaign: 💬 "IDF control over a security zone free of residents, homes and terrorist infrastructure covering nearly 70% of Gaza’s territory." This comes as Israel killed another senior official this week—the Deputy Education Minister—alongside his wife in a strike on their family apartment. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime

В богатых странах растёт количество людей, которые никогда не занимались сексом , — The Economist В США и Великобритании от 5 до 10% людей в возрасте 25-34 лет никогда не занимались сексом . В Японии этот показатель значительно выше: сексуального опыта не имеют каждая пятая женщина и почти каждый третий мужчина этой возрастной категории. Congress was notified of the decision. The package covers Cartridge Actuated Devices/Propellant Actuated Devices (pyrotechnics for systems such as ejection seats), laboratory equipment, and transportation support. It will be added to an existing case and fully funded by Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway through the JUMPSTART programme, with no U.S. funds involved. @OSINTWarfare

NATO’s military activities near Russia’s borders and the involvement of individual alliance countries in attacks on Russian civilian vessels in the Baltic Sea bring the world closer to nuclear war, Russian Permanent Representative to the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) Dmitry Polyansky said. The Russian diplomat pointed to NATO’s military activities near Russian borders taking place in parallel with the Freedom Shield 2026 exercises, during which the unblocking of the Suwalki Corridor is being practiced. According to the Russian diplomat, all of this is happening as part of a single operational plan that envisages, on the one hand, the deployment of troops to Ukraine, and, on the other hand, the blockade of the Kaliningrad Region and the creation of an immediate threat to Belarus.
